title: Los Alamos and QC Ware Model Correlated Iron Oxides Using Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization on IBM Hardware - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Los Alamos National Laboratory and QC Ware used Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization on IBM's ibm_miami to model FeO and Fe2O2, using the QPU only as a Fock-space sampler and reaching chemical accuracy where raw VQE stalled (173 meV error vs 43 meV limit). FeO's experimental quintet state was recovered in just 184 determinants, with a path toward bulk periodic FeO.

themes.theme: SQD beats VQE on correlated oxides

insights.claim: Los Alamos National Laboratory and QC Ware simulated strongly correlated iron oxides (FeO and Fe2O2) with Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization on IBM Quantum's ibm_miami, reaching chemical accuracy where standalone VQE optimization stalls.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Hybrid sampling-plus-classical-diagonalization is emerging as the practical near-term quantum chemistry workflow, benefiting IBM's ecosystem.
insights.quote: using near-term hardware purely as a Fock-space sampler to reach chemical accuracy where standalone Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) optimizations stall
insights.locator: In a preprint titled Towards Quantum

insights.claim: For diatomic FeO, raw VQE left a residual error of about 173 meV, exceeding the 43 meV chemical-accuracy limit, while SQD post-processing recovered the ground doublet within chemical accuracy using only 184 determinants.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Quantifies how far pure variational methods lag; argues against VQE-centric roadmaps.
insights.locator: LANL / QC Ware Correlated Electronic Structure Benchmarks

insights.claim: The SQD workflow recovered FeO's experimental 5Δi quintet state with an excitation energy of 2,167 cm−1, substantially outperforming prior multireference configuration interaction baselines that predicted 300 cm−1.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A concrete case of a quantum-hybrid method beating a classical baseline on a physically relevant quantity.

themes.theme: QPU as sampler, classical does the heavy lifting

insights.claim: To avoid on-hardware barren plateaus, circuit parameters were optimized in classical statevector simulation and the QPU was used strictly for configuration sampling, with classical exact diagonalization of the projected Hamiltonian producing the final energies.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Near-term quantum value is coming from narrow sampling roles inside classical pipelines, not end-to-end quantum computation.
insights.quote: circuit parameters were optimized in classical statevector simulations and deployed to frozen QPUs strictly for configuration sampling

insights.claim: Hardware multiplexing on the 96-qubit ibm_miami ran 6 parallel 16-qubit FeO instances or 3 parallel 32-qubit Fe2O2 instances, using a one-layer LUCJ ansatz with 120 and 496 variational parameters respectively.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Parallel instancing improves QPU utilization for small-active-space chemistry workloads.
insights.locator: LANL / QC Ware Correlated Electronic Structure Benchmarks

insights.claim: The LUCJ ansatz restricts two-mode Givens rotations to nearest-neighbor connectivity, eliminating non-local SWAP overhead on hardware.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Hardware-aware ansatz design is key to running chemistry circuits on limited-connectivity devices.
insights.locator: Bulk FeO is an archetypal Mott

themes.theme: Why FeO matters and next steps

insights.claim: Bulk FeO is an archetypal Mott insulator whose strong electronic correlations cause conventional density functional theory to wrongly predict it is metallic, making it a natural target where quantum methods could add value.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Strongly correlated materials are a credible early application niche where classical DFT fails.
insights.quote: Bulk FeO is an archetypal Mott insulator whose strong electronic correlations cause conventional density functional theory (DFT) to mischaracterize it as metallic.
insights.locator: Bulk FeO is an archetypal Mott

insights.claim: The authors present the method as a blueprint for modeling bulk periodic FeO by distributing SQD sub-blocks across Brillouin zone k-points.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Points to a scaling path from molecules to periodic materials, a prerequisite for industrial materials applications.
insights.quote: The methodology establishes a blueprint for modeling bulk periodic FeO by distributing SQD sub-blocks across Brillouin zone k-points.
